scope: Kafka Provider discovery for every executable declaring cpf.batch.remote.transport=kafka
rootCause: CpfKafkaBindingAutoConfiguration exists but is absent from the starter's AutoConfiguration.imports, so the real Kafka client never becomes a public CpfNamedBrokerClient. Batch executables also do not declare Kafka as their single default binding, and Scheduler declares Kafka transport without depending on the CPF Kafka Starter.
actualError: Both Fresh Workers fail closed: Messaging capability requires one configured broker Provider
requiredFix: Publish the binding auto-configuration, make Kafka the explicit default binding in all Kafka Batch executables, add the missing Scheduler Starter dependency, and guard the complete four-executable contract.
prohibited: Do not inject a smoke-only provider, disable reliability, allow an empty router, or make an implicit provider guess.

sourceFix.executables: Worker, Control Plane, Scheduler, and Center Cut package the CPF Kafka Starter and explicitly select Kafka as the default binding with environment override.
